text:
maria_cs: FYI PrismCare (Anna) asked for a launch-day config change — they want a regional edge peering in eu-west-1 + a temporary rate lift for a controlled ramp. Renewal is in 6 weeks, they tie the launch timing to the contract.
ryan_enginfra: what's the expected QPS and burst profile? need to know if it's sustained or a short ramp.
sam_platform: also need CIDR ranges for their peering and whether they want IP allowlist or header-based gating.
anna_prismcare: Hey team — quick summary: initial steady qps ~50, peak bursts up to 900 qps for ~10–15m after new user batch jobs. We can do a staged ramp over 48h. CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25. We prefer IP allowlist on the proxy and a temporary rate window: 1000 rps for 72h, then back to baseline 200 rps.
maria_cs: noted. Renewal team flagged potential churn if the launch slips. They need the performance data (p50/p90) for the first 48h. Can we surface token-level cost estimates too?
ryan_enginfra: I can provision peering and the allowlist. Need approval for 1000 rps burst; ops-oncall should sanity-check SLO impacts. @sam_platform do we have a prewarmed pool or should we spin up extra dedicated capacity?
sam_platform: We have autoscaling but warmup might take ~6m for GPU-backed instances to stabilize. Recommend temporary dedicated workers in eu-west-1 for 12h post-launch to keep tail latency <200ms. I can submit a capacity request.
proxy-bot: Configuration diff ready for review:
```
proxy: 
  allowlist: [
    "198.51.100.0/24",
    "203.0.113.128/25"
  ]
  rate_windows:
    - name: prismcare-launch
      region: eu-west-1
      limit_rps: 1000
      duration: 259200  # 72h in seconds
      fallback: 200
```
maria_cs: Looks good. Two asks before I greenlight: (1) an automatic revoke after 72h, (2) a short eval prompt set to detect quality regressions during the burst.
anna_prismcare: yes revoke is fine. We'll provide a small prompt set (10 prompts) — they should be sanity checks for hallucination and latency.
ryan_enginfra: I'll queue the peering + allowlist change with an auto-revoke job. tagging ops-oncall for the rate window approval.
sam_platform: Capacity request submitted: 4x dedicated workers in eu-west-1 for 12h starting at launch T+0. Warmup script will pre-run small batches 20m before.
maria_cs: Great — once ops approves I'll open a short runbook for support. Also capture feedback loop: Anna pls ping this channel if anything odd in first 24h. :thumbsup:
anna_prismcare: Will do. Thanks team!
ops-oncall: Approved temporary rate window and peering, will monitor latency and error-rate. Alert thresholds: p50>250ms or 5xx rate >0.5% triggers paging.
maria_cs: Dropping the rollout checklist here: 1) proxy allowlist applied + auto-revoke 2) rate window enabled at T0 3) dedicated workers up and warm 4) eval prompt run every 30m for 48h 5) Postmortem + renewal sync in 3 days.
sam_platform: I'll emit metrics dashboards: token cost, p50/p95 latency, instance utilization.
proxy-bot: Action scheduled: apply-allowlist(198.51.100.0/24,203.0.113.128/25) at 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z, auto-revoke at 2026-03-28T09:00:00Z.
maria_cs: Thanks — creating a renewal note for AE with the launch dependency. Thread closed unless urgent updates.
